sc.label: A glowing light in a sacred valley

slides.text: When he came near, Allah called to him: I am your Lord, so take off your sandals. You are in the holy valley of Tuwa.

ay.ar: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى
ay.en: I am your Lord, so take off your sandals. You are in the holy valley of Tuwa.

sc.label: A soft glow over the valley

slides.text: Allah spoke to Musa and told him the most important thing of all:

ay.ar: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ
ay.en: Truly, I am Allah. There is no god but Me. So worship Me, and pray to remember Me.

sc.label: A wooden staff lying on the ground in the valley

slides.text: Allah gave Musa two signs. When he threw down his staff, it became a moving snake, and Allah said: Take it and do not be afraid. And when he put his hand to his side, it came out shining white.

ay.ar: خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ
ay.en: Take it, and do not be afraid.

sc.label: Dawn over the mountain

slides.text: Allah told Musa to go to Fir'awn. It was a very big job, so Musa made this dua. We can say it too, before a test or when we feel shy:

ay.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
ay.en: My Lord, open my heart, make my job easy for me, and untie the knot in my tongue, so they understand what I say.

sc.label: Two lanterns glowing side by side

slides.text: Musa asked Allah to make his brother Harun his helper. Allah said yes! Then He told them both to speak to Fir'awn gently:

ay.ar: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ
ay.en: Speak to him gently. Maybe he will remember, or be afraid of Allah.

sc.label: A calm night sky full of stars

slides.text: Musa and Harun were scared of Fir'awn. Allah comforted them:

ay.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
ay.en: Do not be afraid. I am with you both. I hear and I see.

sc.label: The proud city under a stormy sky

slides.text: Fir'awn would not listen. He called his magicians to beat Musa. They threw down their ropes and sticks, and with their magic they seemed to move.

sc.label: Light breaking through the clouds over the city

slides.text: Allah told Musa to throw his staff. It swallowed up all their tricks! The magicians knew this was real, from Allah, and they said:

ay.ar: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ay.en: We believe in the Lord of Harun and Musa.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Only Allah deserves our worship. When a job feels too big, say Musa's dua: Rabbish-rahli sadri. Speak the truth gently. And never be afraid of anyone, because Allah hears and sees.

quiz.q: Where did Allah speak to Musa?
o: In the holy valley of Tuwa
quiz.why: He was told to take off his sandals there.

quiz.q: What dua did Musa make before going to Fir'awn?
quiz.why: My Lord, open my heart and make my job easy for me.

quiz.q: Who did Allah make Musa's helper?
quiz.why: Musa asked for Harun, and Allah said yes.

quiz.q: What did the magicians do when they saw the real sign?
quiz.why: They said: We believe in the Lord of Harun and Musa.

stories.title: Prophet Musa: the sea is split
stories.sub: When we are scared, we remember: Allah is with me

sc.label: A quiet city under a starry night

slides.text: Fir'awn still would not let the believers go. So Allah told Musa, alayhis salaam: Travel at night with My servants. You will be followed.

ay.ar: أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ay.en: Travel at night with My servants. You will be followed.

sc.label: Sunrise over a long dusty road

slides.text: Fir'awn gathered his army and chased them. At sunrise, they caught up.

ay.ar: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ
ay.en: So they followed them at sunrise.

sc.label: The sea ahead under a grey sky

slides.text: The believers came to the sea. The sea was in front of them and the army was behind them. They cried: We will be caught! But Musa said:

ay.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ay.en: No! My Lord is with me. He will guide me.

sc.label: The sea split into two tall walls of water

slides.text: Allah told Musa to strike the sea with his staff. The sea split in two, and each side stood up like a huge mountain!

ay.ar: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ay.en: Strike the sea with your staff. And it split, and each side was like a huge mountain.

sc.label: A dry path through the middle of the sea

slides.text: There was a dry path right through the sea. Allah had promised Musa he would not need to be afraid.

ay.ar: فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقٗا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسٗا
ay.en: Strike for them a dry path through the sea.

sc.label: A calm sea under a clear sky

slides.text: Allah saved Musa and everyone with him. When Fir'awn and his army followed, the water closed over them.

ay.ar: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
ay.en: And We saved Musa and all who were with him. Then We drowned the others.

sc.label: Calm waves shining in the sunlight

slides.text: This was a great sign from Allah. The proud king was gone, and the weak people he had hurt were free.

ay.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ
ay.en: Truly, in that is a sign.

sc.label: Sunrise over the sea and the shore

slides.text: Allah is the Almighty, and He is also the Most Merciful.

ay.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ay.en: And your Lord is the Almighty, the Most Merciful.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Even when it looks like there is no way out, Allah can make a way. When you are scared, say like Musa: Kalla, inna ma'iya Rabbi sayahdin. My Lord is with me, He will guide me.

quiz.q: When did Allah tell Musa to leave with the believers?
quiz.why: Travel at night with My servants.

quiz.q: What did Musa say when the army was behind them?
o: My Lord is with me, He will guide me
quiz.why: Kalla, inna ma'iya Rabbi sayahdin.

quiz.q: What happened when Musa struck the sea?
o: It split into two, like mountains
quiz.why: Each side stood up like a huge mountain.

quiz.q: Who did Allah save?
o: Musa and all the believers with him
quiz.why: And We saved Musa and all who were with him.

quiz.q: What did the mountains and birds do with Dawud?
quiz.why: They glorified Allah with him.

quiz.q: If we send one blessing on the Prophet ﷺ, how many does Allah send on us?
quiz.why: Allah sends ten blessings on us. (Sahih Muslim 408)

quiz.q: What did Allah say about giving Maryam a baby?
quiz.why: Nothing is hard for Allah.

quiz.q: Why did Musa go back to his mother?
o: Allah promised it, and Allah keeps His promises
She paid a lot of money
quiz.why: Allah's promise is always true.

quiz.q: Who did Allah send when the Prophet ﷺ was very sad?
quiz.why: The angel of the mountains offered to close the mountains on them.

quiz.q: Which Prophet did he meet in the fourth heaven?
quiz.why: He met Idris in the fourth heaven.

quiz.q: Who found Yusuf in the well?
quiz.why: Travellers let down a bucket and found him.

quiz.q: Who travelled with the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah?
quiz.why: His best friend Abu Bakr went with him.

quiz.q: What did Zakariyya find with Maryam in the mihrab?
quiz.why: Every time, he found food with her.

quiz.q: Why did Yusuf not rush out of prison?
o: He wanted everyone to know he was innocent
quiz.why: He wanted the truth to come out first.
